e: I will go to the market tomorrow.
I will read this book next week.
I will buy a new house next year.
I will leave the house shortly.
I will write you a letter tomorrow.
Tomorrow I will get up early.

q: أَنَا ___ فِي هَذِهِ الشَّرِكَةِ الشَّهْرَ الْقَادِمَ.
e: I will work at this company next month.
I will go back to my country in a year.
I will drink the coffee in a moment.
I will be at home tomorrow.
I will tell the teacher the truth tomorrow.
I will ask the doctor about this tomorrow.

q: هَلْ أَنْتَ ___ إِلَى مِصْرَ الشَّهْرَ الْقَادِمَ؟
e: Will you travel to Egypt next month?
Ahmad, will you come with us tomorrow?
You will arrive at the hotel shortly.
Muhammad, what will you do tomorrow morning?
You will sleep in your brother's room tomorrow.
Will you take the bus tomorrow, Ali?
You will speak with the manager shortly.

q: أَنْتَ ___ الدَّرْسَ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
e: You will understand the lesson tomorrow, God willing.
Yusuf, where will you live in the future?
You will be a skilled doctor in the future.

q: هَلْ ___ أَنْ تَأْتِيَ غَدًا يَا خَالِدُ؟
e: Will you be able to come tomorrow, Khalid?
Sara, what will you cook for dinner tomorrow?

q: يَا لَيْلَى، هَلْ ___ مَعَنَا إِلَى الْبَحْرِ غَدًا؟
e: Layla, will you go to the sea with us tomorrow?

q: أَنْتِ ___ فُسْتَانًا أَحْمَرَ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ الْقَادِمَةِ.
e: You will wear a red dress at the next party.

q: يَا فَاطِمَةُ، هَلْ ___ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ قَبْلَ الْعَشَاءِ غَدًا؟
e: Fatima, will you come back home before dinner tomorrow?
You will know the answer shortly.

q: يَا أُمِّي، هَلْ ___ فِي الْحَدِيقَةِ غَدًا؟
e: Mum, will you sit in the garden tomorrow?
You will find a new job soon.

q: يَا مَرْيَمُ، هَلْ ___ الْعَرَبِيَّةَ فِي الْجَامِعَةِ السَّنَةَ الْقَادِمَةَ؟
e: Maryam, will you study Arabic at university next year?
You will wash the dishes shortly.
My father will come back from work shortly.
The manager will speak with the employees tomorrow.
My brother will buy a new car next month.
He will travel to Cairo the day after tomorrow.
My grandfather will come to us next Friday.
He will cook for his guests tomorrow.
Muhammad will read the letter shortly.
The child will fall asleep shortly.
He will work at the bank next year.
The weather will be nice tomorrow.
He will wash his car tomorrow morning.
My sister will write a letter to our grandmother tomorrow.

q: سَارَةُ ___ فُسْتَانًا جَدِيدًا فِي حَفْلَةِ الْغَدِ.
e: Sara will wear a new dress at tomorrow's party.
My mother will go to the market tomorrow morning.

q: هِيَ ___ الدِّرَاسَةَ فِي الْجَامِعَةِ الشَّهْرَ الْقَادِمَ.
e: She will start her studies at university next month.
The teacher will ask the students about the lesson tomorrow.

q: جَدَّتِي ___ مَعَنَا فِي هَذَا الْبَيْتِ قَرِيبًا.
e: My grandmother will live with us in this house soon.
She will give the present to her mother tomorrow.
Layla will walk in the park shortly.
She will leave the office in an hour.
We will eat at the restaurant tomorrow evening.

q: نَحْنُ ___ كُرَةَ الْقَدَمِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ الْقَادِمِ.
e: We will play football next Friday.
We will take the train to Alexandria tomorrow.

q: أَنَا وَأَخِي ___ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ بَعْدَ قَلِيلٍ.
e: My brother and I will go back home shortly.

q: نَحْنُ ___ الْعَرَبِيَّةَ مَعَ مُعَلِّمٍ جَدِيدٍ السَّنَةَ الْقَادِمَةَ.
e: We will study Arabic with a new teacher next year.
We will give the presents to the children tomorrow.
We will arrive in the city tomorrow morning.
We will speak with the doctor shortly.
We will leave the hotel early tomorrow.
We will walk to school tomorrow.
Children, you will drink the juice in a moment.

q: يَا شَبَابُ، مَتَى ___ إِلَى الْمَطَارِ غَدًا؟
e: Guys, when will you arrive at the airport tomorrow?
You will understand the new lesson tomorrow.

q: هَلْ ___ فِي هَذَا الْفُنْدُقِ غَدًا يَا أَصْدِقَائِي؟
e: Will you sleep in this hotel tomorrow, my friends?

q: أَنْتُمْ ___ الْمَدِينَةَ الْقَدِيمَةَ مِنَ الْبُرْجِ غَدًا.
e: You will see the old city from the tower tomorrow.
Students, you will start the exam shortly.

q: أَنْتُمْ ___ عَلَى هَذِهِ الطَّاوِلَةِ بَعْدَ قَلِيلٍ.
e: You will sit at this table shortly.
You will come here next week.
Will you play with us tomorrow, boys?

q: هُمْ ___ إِلَى الْأُرْدُنِّ فِي الصَّيْفِ الْقَادِمِ.
e: They will travel to Jordan next summer.
The students will take the new books tomorrow.
My friends will come from Lebanon the day after tomorrow.

q: هُمْ ___ فِي بَيْتٍ كَبِيرٍ السَّنَةَ الْقَادِمَةَ.
e: They will live in a big house next year.

q: الْأَوْلَادُ ___ فِي الْحَدِيقَةِ غَدًا بَعْدَ الدَّرْسِ.
e: The boys will play in the park tomorrow after the lesson.
They will eat fish at dinner tomorrow.
They will hear the news shortly.
The workers will open the factory in an hour.
They will go back to their homes shortly.
I will visit my grandmother in hospital tomorrow.
I will call you shortly.
I will wait here after the lesson tomorrow.
I will pass the next exam.
Omar, will you help your brother tomorrow?
You will teach the students Arabic next year.
Will you watch the match tomorrow evening?
You will leave the house early tomorrow.

q: يَا هُدَى، هَلْ ___ فِي الْحَفْلَةِ غَدًا؟
e: Huda, will you sing at the party tomorrow?
You will send the letter shortly.

q: يَا رِيمُ، هَلْ ___ فِي الصَّيْفِ الْقَادِمِ؟
e: Reem, will you get married next summer?
You will draw a picture of the sea tomorrow.
My brother will sell his old car next month.
The teacher will answer your question tomorrow.
He will close the shop shortly.
My father will pay the bill shortly.
My mother will make a cake for my birthday tomorrow.
She will swim in the sea shortly.
My sister will wake up early tomorrow.
The manager will meet the new employees next week.

q: نَحْنُ ___ جَدَّتَنَا فِي دِمَشْقَ الصَّيْفَ الْقَادِمَ.
e: We will visit our grandmother in Damascus next summer.

q: نَحْنُ ___ بَيْتًا قُرْبَ الْبَحْرِ السَّنَةَ الْقَادِمَةَ.
e: We will build a house near the sea next year.
We will invite our friends to dinner tomorrow.
We will dance at the party tomorrow.
You will learn a new language next year.
Will you carry the bags tomorrow, guys?
You will run in the race shortly.

q: أَنْتُمْ ___ هَذَا الْحَاسُوبَ فِي الدَّرْسِ الْقَادِمِ.
e: You will use this computer in the next lesson.
The students will listen to the lecture tomorrow.
Our neighbours will leave the neighbourhood next month.

q: هُمْ ___ عَنْ عَمَلٍ جَدِيدٍ السَّنَةَ الْقَادِمَةَ.
e: They will look for new work next year.
They will try again tomorrow.
Girls, you will dance at the theatre tomorrow.
You will help the children with their drawing tomorrow.

q: يَا طَالِبَاتُ، ___ الْكُتُبَ إِلَى الْمَكْتَبَةِ غَدًا.
e: Students, you will carry the books to the library tomorrow.
You will meet the director next week.
The girls will swim in the pool shortly.
The female students will visit the museum tomorrow.
They will wait for the train at the station tomorrow.
My sisters will call me shortly.
The two boys will go to school tomorrow.
The two girls will take part in the competition next week.
You two will stay here tomorrow, won't you?

q: يَا أَحْمَدُ وَيَا سَمِيرُ، هَلْ ___ مَعَنَا غَدًا؟
e: Ahmad and Samir, will you two travel with us tomorrow?
The two players will win the next match.

q: الْأُخْتَانِ ___ إِلَى شَقَّةٍ جَدِيدَةٍ الشَّهْرَ الْقَادِمَ.
e: The two sisters will move to a new flat next month.

q: أَنَا ___ مَا أَدْرُسُ فِي الْجَامِعَةِ قَرِيبًا.
e: I will choose what to study at university soon.
The engineer will explain the problem to us shortly.
My father will repair the washing machine tomorrow.

q: نَحْنُ ___ بِعِيدِ مِيلَادِ أُمِّي الْأُسْبُوعَ الْقَادِمَ.
e: We will celebrate my mother's birthday next week.
She will confirm the meeting time tomorrow.
You will welcome the guests at the airport tomorrow.
They will change their minds after the next trip.
The rain will stop shortly.

q: يَا مَرْيَمُ، هَلْ ___ فِي هَذَا الْعَمَلِ السَّنَةَ الْقَادِمَةَ؟
e: Maryam, will you carry on in this job next year?
You will earn a lot of money soon.
The female students will memorise the poem before the next ceremony.

q: الْمُمَرِّضَتَانِ ___ الْمَرِيضَ إِلَى غُرْفَةٍ أُخْرَى بَعْدَ قَلِيلٍ.
e: The two nurses will move the patient to another room shortly.
You two will reply to the letter tomorrow.

q: الصَّدِيقَانِ ___ الْمَالَ مِنْ أَجْلِ الرِّحْلَةِ الشَّهْرَ الْقَادِمَ.
e: The two friends will collect the money for the trip next month.
